Commands
Every command and subcommand: usage, options, examples, exit codes, and what it does outside a project.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

In global mode: each command declares its behavior outside projects (`outsideProject`). Most answer like a new project; some write nothing and name the project they need; `doctor`, `init`, and `upgrade` behave differently. Commands with different behavior describe it in their `In global mode:` note, and CLI tests run each command in an empty folder against its declared value. Inside a project, the project's Astryx release runs every command, whichever astryx command you type. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`.

blog                              astryx blog: Read the Astryx blog from the published feed
build                             astryx build: Build a page: the template to start from, or the workflow playbook (no
                                  query)
component                         astryx component: List components or print component docs
discover                          astryx discover: Browse and search integrations: the ones you have and the ones you
                                  could add
docs                              astryx docs: Print reference docs
doctor                            astryx doctor: Diagnose Astryx projects and integration packages
doctor-integration                astryx doctor integration: Check an integration package while authoring it
doctor-integration-components     astryx doctor integration components: Check integration component names, replacements,
                                  and documented props
doctor-integration-docs           astryx doctor integration docs: Check an integration's docs: the docs tree they add,
                                  every link, and overlaps with Core topics
doctor-integration-templates      astryx doctor integration templates: Validate integration template replacements and
                                  Core id overlaps
doctor-integration-validate       astryx doctor integration validate: Validate an integration manifest and its
                                  contributions
experimental                      [experimental] astryx experimental: Try features that may change in a patch release:
                                  icon sets (find icons, build an icon-set package)
experimental-icon                 [experimental] astryx experimental icon: Find an icon by meaning, or build an icon set
                                  from a library (guide: astryx docs cli/experimental/icon-sets)
experimental-icon-add             [experimental] astryx experimental icon add: Register one icon you chose from a
                                  library in your icon set
experimental-icon-map             [experimental] astryx experimental icon map: Register which icon of your set draws an
                                  icon definition
experimental-icon-new-definition  [experimental] astryx experimental icon new-definition: Add your icon set's own icon
                                  definition
experimental-icon-new-set         [experimental] astryx experimental icon new-set: Start an icon set in your integration
                                  package
experimental-icon-use             [experimental] astryx experimental icon use: Choose the project's icon set
experimental-render               [experimental] astryx experimental render: Render a page to one self-contained HTML
                                  file, or turn one back into a page
gap-report                        astryx gap-report: Report a missing component or feature to the package that owns it
hook                              astryx hook: List hooks or print hook docs
init                              astryx init: Initialize the design system in your project
integration                       astryx integration: Author and verify an Astryx integration package
integration-add                   astryx integration add: Add one working contribution to an integration package
integration-check                 astryx integration check: The CI check for an integration package's own build: every
                                  source check, run in continuous integration or a typecheck script, against the package
                                  in the current folder
integration-pack                  astryx integration pack: Deprecated: the old name of `integration verify`
integration-verify                astryx integration verify: Check the package the way npm will publish it, before you
                                  publish
manifest                          astryx manifest: Print the full CLI capability manifest (use with --json)
postinstall                       astryx postinstall: Print the welcome message shown after install
search                            astryx search: Search components, hooks, docs, templates, and themes in one ranked
                                  list
swizzle                           astryx swizzle: Copy component source for customization
template                          astryx template: List, show, or scaffold page and block templates
theme                             astryx theme: Add, switch, build, and author themes
theme-add                         astryx theme add: Add a built theme to the app. To copy a theme's source as an
                                  editable fork, run `theme eject <slug> [path] [--overwrite]`.
theme-build                       astryx theme build: Compile standalone themes or one keyed theme family
theme-eject                       astryx theme eject: Fork a theme as editable local source
theme-list                        astryx theme list: List themes available to add
theme-palette                     astryx theme palette: Create and work with theme-owned color palettes
theme-palette-generate            astryx theme palette generate: Generate an OKLCH palette candidate for human review
theme-remove                      astryx theme remove: Remove a non-default theme from the app
theme-targets                     astryx theme targets: List the component theming targets a theme can override
theme-template                    astryx theme template: Write the annotated theme template into your project
theme-use                         astryx theme use: Choose the app default from its added themes
upgrade                           astryx upgrade: Update your code after upgrading Astryx, and refresh ShadCN-copied
                                  components

Open one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/<name>
Up: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli
Next: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/api
